scope.timing: Complete original owner fixture/runner/shutdown milliseconds; preparation and input hashing excluded. Custom-browser diagnostic only; not final admission or a sampler-overhead estimate.

symbolResolution.method: Original perf mmap/fork/exec records; latest covering process mapping; file offsets joined to exact executable PT_LOAD segments and sized STT_FUNC/IFUNC intervals. Folded/overlapping function names retained together. Caller return addresses subtract one byte; sampled instruction pointers do not.

independentCheck.aliases: LLVM reported function must belong to complete matching ELF function alias set; no arbitrary alias chosen
independentCheck.limits: Deterministic prefix address controls; not an independent verification of unwind validity or every sample address.

symbolResolution.mappingControl: A read/execute mmap of exact binary bytes without execution joins its inode to the local mapping device. Mapping device differs from stat device on this filesystem; original control retained.
symbolResolution.jitPolicy: No JIT symbol resolution. Anonymous, external-library, unmapped and native-unsymbolized samples remain explicit; native functions do not identify a JavaScript URL.

decision: TodoMVC Scanner::Next accounts for 500 and 513 samples. Captured ancestry includes Compiler::CollectSourcePositions in 248 and 253 of those samples, and Console::Info in 191 and 203. This is partly stack-location work; treating all scanner work as initial application compilation would be incorrect.
Most TodoMVC scanner samples overlap navigation windows (422 and 435). This temporal association is not exclusive request ownership or a critical-path measure.
SVGOMG has 40 and 30 scanner samples and a broader distribution including raster work. These workloads do not establish one universal browser hotspot.

No optimization selected or adopted from flat sample shares. Existing eager source-position, compiler-tier, renderer reuse and cache-composition negative results still apply; do not repeat them unchanged. Any new source-position mechanism must preserve complete console/error diagnostics and capture-time code identity through GC, live edit and destruction.
retainedCorrection: Repeating the exclusive-output input verifier reached its final write and failed with EEXIST. The original integrity receipt was preserved; identical assertions passed with a new output filename. No workload was rerun.
limitations: Four profiled fresh launches and four timestamp-instrumented controls; two per application/arm. No confidence interval, tail estimate, broad performance result or exact CPU total.
Fixed task-clock sampling can undersample short-lived threads. Nominal period sums are not calibrated CPU totals. Kernel work is excluded.

Many scanner callchains reach the configured 65-entry cap: 01-todomvc-on 445/500, 02-svgomg-on 19/40, 05-svgomg-on 12/30, 06-todomvc-on 445/513. Callchain ancestry is positive evidence only; unwind incompleteness and inlining can obscure callers.

Function aliases from linker folding are preserved; a count belongs to the shared address range, not independently to every alias. LLVM controls check deterministic prefixes, not every sample or unwind validity.
Browser build/distribution differs from stock full Chrome and stock headless shell; do not pool these timings with earlier stock results.
Input identities and observed clean watchdog teardown do not establish final cgroup resource admission, cold filesystem caches, native CI or release readiness.
Public export omits workstation paths, private raw source bodies and full callchain lists. Raw source/outcomes/receipts remain in ignored workbench; digest references identify them.
